//: Emits the test tree, and the sources it reaches. rootDir is the REPO root, not ./src: gitService.ts imports the shared git core from ../../src/main/git-core.ts (#191), and rootDir has to contain every input. So the compiled tree is out/<path from the repo root>/ — out/vscode-extension/src/test/suite/*.js for the tests, out/src/main/*.js for what they reach outside the extension. The three places that locate it by path are package.json's `test` script, scripts/test-nodisplay.js and runTests.ts's extensionDevelopmentPath; .vscodeignore keeps the whole tree out of the .vsix, which ships the esbuild bundle out/extension.js and nothing else.
